rationale: Complete pinned HAMT/transient/sequence algorithm retained. Explicit defn, doto, if-let and exact forEach bootstrap preserve all branches and evaluation order; Error construction uses the typed adapter and threshold spelling follows the pinned emitter. Native execution/transport and broader compatibility remain unfinished. Original Suss: a return-only long hint exposes the existing guaranteed int32 result to primitive callers, without narrowing the boxed operands or changing ToInt32 conversion.
